Full regular seasons for the five reviewed scorecard teams

Source: R/reviewed_team_seasons.R
reviewed_team_seasons.Rd

Every completed regular-season game for the team and season of each reviewed scorecard: 2026 Arizona Diamondbacks, Cleveland Guardians, New York Mets and St. Louis Cardinals, and 2024 Minnesota Twins. Each team-season has 162 games, and each reviewed scorecard game appears in its team's season. Built with season_games().

Usage

reviewed_team_seasons

Format

A data frame with 810 rows and 10 columns:

game_id

Character MLB game identifier (gamePk).

team

Character team name.

season

Integer season.

game_date

Date of the game.

home

Logical, TRUE for home games.

opponent

Character opponent name.

runs, runs_allowed

Integer runs scored and allowed.

run_diff

Integer runs minus runs allowed.

win

Numeric 1 for a win, 0 for a loss.

Source

MLB Stats API regular-season schedules retrieved November 8, 2026, kept in data-raw/schedules/ in the source repository and processed by data-raw/team-seasons.R. URL pattern: https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule?sportId=1&teamId=142&season=2024&gameType=R.

Details

Win and loss totals match the final league record reported in each schedule. Filter to one team before calling compare_personal_season(), which compares within one team-season.

Examples

aggregate(cbind(games = 1, win) ~ team + season, reviewed_team_seasons, sum)
#>                   team season games win
#> 1      Minnesota Twins   2024   162  82
#> 2 Arizona Diamondbacks   2026   162  86
#> 3  Cleveland Guardians   2026   162  85
#> 4        New York Mets   2026   162  74
#> 5  St. Louis Cardinals   2026   162  77
twins <- subset(reviewed_team_seasons, team == "Minnesota Twins")
set.seed(457)
compare_personal_season(twins, "746804", metric = "run_diff")$summary
#>     metric selected_games other_games personal_mean other_mean season_mean
#> 1 run_diff              1         161             1 0.03726708  0.04320988
#>   difference reference_low reference_high reference_percentile
#> 1  0.9627329           -11              8                   58
